messages.subject: Error in AHM2, Sec. 10.5 (binned counts)
parts:
Dear all,

for the AHM project, we don't (currently) have a book website where we can post errors found. Hence, I report an error on this list. This way, there is some chance that users can avoid it.

My colleague Nicolas Strebel just pointed out to me the following error in the data manipulation of the integrated model for binned counts, on page 600 in the AHM2 book. Here, the limits for the dinterval function in JAGS are defined as 0 10 25 50 100 200

However, due to the way how dinterval is defined in JAGS (see page 55 in the manual), this does then not allow a value of 0 for the responses that are in class 1. Therefore, we should have chosen the limits as follows: -1 10 25 50 100 200


In the example in the book, correcting the analysis makes hardly any difference to the inferences, but this will of course not always be so.


Thanks and best regards – Marc
